target.title: add stable backport release workflow skill
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw's stable maintenance process needs a repeatable way to discover the complete set of security and reliability fixes for the most recently published stable release. The source set must include direct commits and private security work, not only public PRs, and covered plugin fixes need coordinated ordering with core.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a manually invoked `$openclaw-stable-backport` skill that resolves the active/latest stable release, inventories the full mainline delta in bounded batches, reconciles private advisories, carries unresolved candidates across runs, and prepares one approved multi-commit backport batch. The workflow uses the stable-line metadata from #95613 and stable plugin planner from #95117 when available, while failing closed before those authoritative tools land.

## User Impact

No product runtime behavior changes. Maintainers gain a practical release-level workflow for discovering, reviewing, backporting, validating, and handing off the full targeted patch set for the latest stable release.

## Evidence

- `python3 /Users/dallin/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py .agents/skills/openclaw-stable-backport`
- `git diff --check`
- `pnpm docs:list`
- Dry-run resolution against the current published stable release confirmed `v2026.6.11`, `origin/release/2026.6.11`, tag reachability, and a valid mainline scan cursor.
- Reviewed the live contracts and branch heads for #95117 and #95613, including stable-line metadata, `stable/<baseVersion>` ownership, covered plugin manifest, planner arguments, plugin-first order, activation hold, and partial-failure states.
- Final autoreview: clean with no accepted/actionable findings.
